Model card: FluidAudio Web — raw model weights Model weights for **fluidaudio-web**: fully in-browser inference (WebGPU + WebAssembly) for FluidAudio's speech models. These are **raw weights only — no ONNX, no onnxruntime.** Each engine is a hand-written forward pass (WebGPU/WASM/JS) that loads these tensors directly and, where applicable, dequantizes them in-shader. Weights are extracted from the source models and parity-verified against the originals before publishing. Layout (one folder per engine) | folder | model | weights | |---|---|---| | | Silero VAD v5 (16 kHz) | fp32 | | | Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3 | int8 encoder + fp32 decoder/joint | | | Nemotron 3.5 streaming ASR 0.6B (40 langs) | int8 encoder + fp32 decoder | | | Parakeet EOU 120M (end-of-utterance ASR) | fp16 encoder + fp32 decoder | | | NVIDIA VoiceChat-11B user-transcription chain (609M causal FastConformer + RNNT) | fp16 encoder + fp32 decoder | | | Whisper base | fp32 encoder + fp32 decoder | | | Sortformer streaming diarization 4spk v2.1 | int8 encoder + fp32 head | | | Kokoro TTS 82M — English | fp32 | | | Kokoro TTS 82M — Chinese | fp32 | Format - — concatenated little-endian tensors. - — (offset/len in **elements**, not bytes). Load: fetch the , slice each tensor per the manifest. Extraction scripts and the forward passes live in the fluidaudio-web repo ( , ). Quantized engines additionally carry per-tensor scales / palettes (documented per folder) for in-shader dequant.
